title: My Stepson Forged My Signature And Sold My Stake For Millions. So I Let Him Scrub Fermenters.
description: When my stepson forged my signature, sold the craft brewery I built with my late husband's life insurance for $1.3M, and tried to pay me off with $10K, I exposed the fraud using bank footage and won everything in court. Now I run Hops of Betrayal Brewing, where my Equity Stout's QR code links to his guilty verdict and he scrubs fermenters in a shirt that reads Brewed Lies. #RevengeStory #BreweryBetrayal #EquityStout
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY BREWERY. NOW HE SCRUBS FERMENTERS.
pinned_comment: If your stepson forged your name to steal a $1.3 million brewery sale and handed you a $10,000 'settlement,' would you have fought back in court or let it go? Tell me your story.

thumb_lines.text: HANDED ME A $10,000 CHECK AND CALLED IT GENEROUS
